arrays.value: 12 m array and ACA observed; only 12 m array used here

evidence.quote: These ALMA projects included both 12 m array and Atacama Compact Array (ACA) observations.

referee_caveats_inferred: Seven- and eight-region correlations are sensitive to sample selection and individual sources.
The evolutionary indicator is proposed and tested within the same small sample; its monotonicity is not independently calibrated here.
Q and the new indicator reuse core associations and literature measurements, so correlated uncertainties deserve explicit treatment.
Distance tests with very small subsamples have limited power to exclude resolution or completeness effects.
The standard deviation across a few catalogue variants is not a full probabilistic uncertainty model for Q.
A correlation across different protoclusters does not directly measure temporal evolution or establish global collapse.
